message.content:
Reorganize the ADMIN sidebar in /opt/nxeon (Next.js 15). Right now the admin sidebar shows only 6 top-level group items (Insights/Customers/Fleet/Revenue/Platform/System) with a cramped horizontal sub-tab bar (AdminSubTabs) at the top of each page. The owner wants the sidebar itself to hold the navigation — the sub-items should appear IN the sidebar under their group (filling it), and the horizontal tab bar should go away. Do NOT run git. Do NOT touch prisma/schema.prisma or anything under app/dashboard or app/(marketing) (the customer portal shares the Shell — must not regress).

Target behavior — **expandable sidebar groups**:
- The sidebar lists the 6 groups from `lib/admin-groups.ts` (ADMIN_GROUPS: {label, icon, items:[{label,href}...]}). Read that file — it's the source of truth.
- The group that contains the CURRENT route is **expanded**, rendering its member items as indented sub-links in the sidebar (highlight the active one). Other groups render as a collapsed header row.
- Clicking a collapsed group header navigates to that group's first item (which then expands it on the new page). Optionally also allow expand-on-click without navigating — but keep it simple: header links to the first item; active group auto-expands. (A pure CSS/`usePathname` client approach is fine — the group is "open" iff `pathname` startsWith one of its item hrefs, matching the existing `groupForPath` longest-prefix logic.)
- **Remove the horizontal AdminSubTabs** from the admin layout (`app/admin/layout.tsx`) since navigation now lives in the sidebar. You may delete the `<AdminSubTabs />` render; leave the component file in place (unused) unless trivial to remove cleanly.
- **Badges**: keep the existing attention-count badges. When a group is COLLAPSED, show the rolled-up group total on the header (as today). When EXPANDED, show per-item badges on the individual sub-links (chat/support/feedback/abuse/improvements counts — the per-route `badges` map already exists in the layout). Preserve all the gates (adminHostBlocked, adminIpBlocked, 2FA, impersonation) untouched.

Implementation notes:
- `components/portal/Shell.tsx` is SHARED with the customer portal. Add support for nested/expandable nav WITHOUT changing customer behavior: e.g. extend the nav item type with an optional `children?: {label,href,badge?}[]` and, when present, render the expandable group treatment; when absent (customer portal), render exactly as today. The customer layout passes no children, so it's unaffected. Match the existing sidebar styling (indent sub-items, a subtle active state, chevron optional).
- Build the nested nav in `app/admin/layout.tsx` from ADMIN_GROUPS + the active-path check + the badge maps.
- The sidebar should look full and organized but must not overflow awkwardly — only the active group is expanded, so the visible item count stays reasonable. Ensure it scrolls gracefully if a very long group (Revenue/Platform) is expanded.

Verify: `cd /opt/nxeon && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v "test/.*test.ts"` clean and `npm run build` exits 0. Confirm the CUSTOMER portal nav still renders unchanged (Shell backward-compatible). Report the approach, the Shell type change, and confirm gates/badges preserved.

1	/**
2	 * Grouped structure for the admin ops portal.
3	 *
4	 * The sidebar shows one TOP-LEVEL entry per group (its `href` points at the
5	 * group's first member). Each grouped page renders a horizontal sub-tab bar for
6	 * its siblings via <AdminSubTabs /> (see components/admin/SubTabs.tsx), so the
7	 * ~40 admin routes stay one click apart without cluttering the sidebar.
8	 *
9	 * This module is intentionally free of any server-only imports so it can be

11	 * sub-tab bar.

113	/**
114	 * Resolve which group a given admin pathname belongs to, by longest matching
115	 * member href. Detail routes (e.g. /admin/users/123) resolve to their group via
116	 * the prefix match. The bare "/admin" only ever matches the Insights overview
117	 * so it never swallows deeper routes.
118	 */
119	export function groupForPath(pathname: string): AdminGroup | null {
120	  let best: { group: AdminGroup; len: number } | null = null;
121	  for (const group of ADMIN_GROUPS) {
122	    for (const item of group.items) {
123	      const matches =
124	        pathname === item.href ||
125	        (item.href !== "/admin" && pathname.startsWith(item.href + "/"));
126	      if (matches && (!best || item.href.length > best.len)) {
127	        best = { group, len: item.href.length };
128	      }
129	    }
130	  }
131	  return best?.group ?? null;
132	}

The customer nav passes no `children`, so it renders through the unchanged flat-link branch. Everything is done and verified.

## Summary

Reorganized the admin sidebar in `/opt/nxeon` so navigation lives in an expandable sidebar and the horizontal `AdminSubTabs` bar is gone.

### Approach
The sidebar now renders the 6 `ADMIN_GROUPS` as expandable groups. Which group is open is derived purely client-side from `usePathname()` using the same longest-prefix match as `groupForPath` (bare `/admin` matches exactly; deeper routes prefix-match on `href + "/"`). The group owning the current route expands to show its members as indented sub-links with the active one highlighted; every other group is a collapsed header row. Clicking a collapsed header navigates to that group's first accessible member, which then auto-expands it on the new page.

### Shell type change (`components/portal/Shell.tsx`)
- Extracted `NavItem` / `NavChild` types and added an optional `children?: NavChild[]` (`{label, href, badge?}`) to nav items. `NavSection` now references `NavItem`.
- When `children` is present → expandable-group rendering (header link + indented sub-links, chevron rotates when open, sub-links reuse `nav-item-active` for the active gradient, indented under a hairline left border). When absent → the exact original flat `<Link>` branch, so the customer portal is byte-for-byte unchanged.
- Command-palette `flatNav` now expands children (so admin sub-routes are searchable); flat items pass through identically for customers.
- Long expanded groups scroll within the existing `flex-1 overflow-y-auto` nav container.

### Layout change (`app/admin/layout.tsx`)
- Removed the `<AdminSubTabs />` render and its import (component file left in place, now unused; no other file references it).
- Built the nested nav from `ADMIN_GROUPS` filtered per-role via `canAccessHref` (empty groups dropped; header links to first *accessible* member).
- Badges: each group header carries the rolled-up group total (shown by the Shell only while collapsed); each child carries its own per-route count (shown while expanded). Same soft-failing counts (chat/support/abuse/feedback/improvements).

### Gates & verification
- All gates preserved untouched: `adminHostBlocked` (→404), `adminIpBlocked`, staff `enforce_staff_2fa`, and impersonation redirect.
- `npx tsc --noEmit` (excluding test files): clean.
- `npm run build`: exit 0.
- Did not run git; did not touch `prisma/schema.prisma`, `app/dashboard`, or `app/(marketing)`. Customer Shell confirmed backward-compatible (its nav passes no `children`).

Files changed: `/opt/nxeon/components/portal/Shell.tsx`, `/opt/nxeon/app/admin/layout.tsx`.
